text:
anya.k: Heads-up: audit surfaced continued use of the ephemeral KSA proxy in the gpu-pool. We promised to deprecate it last quarter but some jobs still hit it. Need a short plan (risk, rollback, telemetry) before next deploy window.

sam_g: ugh, ok. what are the biggest risks if we disable it?

anya.k: main risks: sudden 403s on older deploy jobs, token refresh failures for long-running training jobs, and gaps in KMS-encrypted key unwraps if code path assumes proxy key access.

leo: can we feature-flag it? add an env var to the controller to route new pods away from proxy first, then flip after 48h of no errors.

marie.p: +1 to feature flag. also we should add a short audit query to detect any remaining callers before flip. i can add a saved query in the SIEM.

ops-oncall: from oncall perspective: if we see 403 spike we want an automatic fallback to the older token path and a pager threshold at >5% error rate for 5m.

sec-bot: Detector: ephemeral-ksa-proxy-usage - 12 calls in last 24h from namespace finance-ml.

sam_g: finance-ml? that's a customer workload on dedicated. we need to coordinate with infra-account owners before flipping.

anya.k: agree. proposed plan: 1) add telemetry and saved SIEM query (marie) 2) add feature flag and safe fallback route (leo) 3) reach out to infra-account owners + schedule maintenance window (sam) 4) run a staged disable in canary pools + monitor 24h 5) full disable and rotate any KMS wrapping keys if proxy had access.

leo: implementation notes: flag name `ENABLE_EPHEMERAL_KSA_PROXY=false` on controller; controller logs will emit: `ksa.proxy.route=deprecated` and increment metric `ksa_proxy.deprecated_hits`. we should also emit the original serviceaccount name in logs (redacted) for triage.

marie.p: SIEM query: `event.action: "ksa.proxy.call" AND NOT tag:deprecated` will show live callers. i'll create a dashboard and set alert at >=1 for finance-ml and >=5 for infra namespaces.

ops-oncall: add automatic rollback job: if error rate >5% for 10m, controller flips `ENABLE_EPHEMERAL_KSA_PROXY=true` and posts to #incidents. who owns that runbook?

anya.k: runbook owner: sam_g. sam can you draft quick steps (investigate logs, re-enable flag, open ticket to affected team)?

sam_g: yes. will draft and ping infra-account owners. also need guidance on KMS key rotation: do we rotate wrapping keys only if proxy key material leaked?

leo: rotate only if audit shows proxy performed decrypt/unwrapping. otherwise rotate wrapping metadata (key policy referencing proxy) to remove proxy principals; that avoids rotating data keys.

marie.p: i can query KMS audit logs: `resourceName:"projects/redwood/locations/*/keyRings/*/cryptoKeys/*" protoPayload.methodName: "Decrypt"` should show decrypt callers. i'll run that and report results in this thread.

sec-bot: Action created: ksa-proxy-deprecate-2798765432 assigned to sam_g, due in 3d.

ops-oncall: tag me when you start the canary so we can watch latency/403.

anya.k: timeline: collect telemetry + SIEM alerts today, feature flag PR tomorrow (leo), coordinate accounts (sam) and canary next Wed in maintenance window. if no blockers, full disable Thu next week.

sam_g: noted. i'll start drafting the runbook and ping finance infra owner.

leo: i'll open the PR and include test plan + metrics dashboard links. will add the fallback flip code as a safety net.

marie.p: ran KMS decrypt query: 3 decrypt events from proxy principal in last 30d, all from staging namespaces. forwarding raw results to sam_g.

anya.k: thanks. low activity is encouraging. lets proceed with the staged plan. i'll update infra change log and send calendar invites. :thumbsup:
